classification: post-hoc defensive-bucket selection rule using cached frozen R344 equity sleeves

costs.defensive_switch: round-trip cost times one-way turnover of the top-two allocation

defensive_rule.selection: Hold the top two ETFs at 50% each after the signal; the signal applies only to subsequent returns.
defensive_rule.signal: At each monthly rebalance, rank the three ETFs by total return over the trailing 60 trading days through the signal close.

discipline: One fixed defensive top-two selection rule; no parameter or weight scan
Reuse only frozen R344 strategy curves after exact baseline reconstruction
No paper target or order file
Preserve execution failures, preflight errors and amendments
disclosure: R344 and later candidate results were observed before this round. R349 is explicitly post-hoc and tests one fixed defensive selection rule; no lookback, asset count, weighting, cap, cost or threshold scan is permitted. The coverage-only preflight inspected asset coverage, selection frequency and turnover only. No R349 portfolio return, drawdown, trade or concentration result was inspected before this file was frozen.
economic_rationale: Gold, treasury and dividend ETFs have distinct macro exposures. A monthly top-two relative-momentum rule can rotate away from the weakest defensive regime while staying fully invested in two liquid defensive assets and avoiding an asset-weight optimization grid.

frozen_equity_construction.cache: data/research/r344_cache frozen strategy curves; the runner must reconstruct R344 center, 3x-conservative, 4x and 5x stats within 2e-6 before evaluating R349
frozen_equity_construction.overlay: 60-day lookback, 15% balance-vol target, gross [0.20, 1.00], no leverage
frozen_equity_construction.sleeve_weighting: monthly 60-day inverse-volatility risk parity with [0.20, 0.60] bounds, then cap C at 10% and redistribute excess to A/B

absolute_performance_2x.G10_no_leverage: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0

concentration.C12: max weight sum <=1, min target weight >=0
concentration.C8: each actual asset contribution <=50%, using the top-two defensive contribution stream rather than equal-thirds accounting
concentration.C9: each actual total-portfolio defensive asset mean <=40%, max <=50%

data.D2_preflight: all coverage/selection checks true and no returns evaluated
data.D3_r344_cache_reconstructs_control: R344 center, 3x-conservative, 4x and 5x stats reproduced within 2e-6
data.D4_cache_and_assets_stable: cache and defensive asset inputs remain byte-hash stable

robustness.F1_fresh: at least 5/6 fresh starts positive and every MDD >= -18%
robustness.P1_overlay: >=7/9 overlay lookback/target variants pass core gates
robustness.P2_joint: >=2/3 joint target variants pass core gates

satellite_cap_plateau.P4: at least 3/4 caps pass and the 10% center passes
satellite_cap_plateau.per_cap_core: 2x annual >=12%, Sharpe >=1.25, MDD >= -15%; 5x annual >=10%, Sharpe >=1.10, MDD >= -15%; 5x C2-C4 pass; at least 5/6 fresh starts positive

hypothesis: Replacing the fixed one-third defensive bucket with a monthly 60-day dual-momentum top-two rule reduces equity-correlated drawdown and improves recent-year and 2022 experience without changing the frozen A/B equity sleeves, C sleeve, 10% satellite cap, 1/3 equity-risk share, 15% volatility target or leverage constraint.
known_limitations: R349 is post-hoc after observing R344-R348 results and is not an independent out-of-sample discovery.
The common window begins in 2022 because TTM data for the C sleeve begins then.
ETF qfq caches are not official PIT total-return series and do not model premium/discount.
The rule is evaluated on current reconstructed HS300 membership and current-snapshot industry classification.
Top-two momentum can whipsaw around month boundaries despite the 50% turnover cap.
The runner depends on the frozen R344 cache; exact baseline reconstruction is required before candidate evaluation.

preflight_erratum.effect: Canonical pair counts only; selection rule and checks unchanged.

reference_control.construction: fixed one-third defensive bucket with the gold 200-day trend proxy

selection_rule: All D/G/T/X/C/R/F/P gates must pass. Otherwise record the result as research-only negative evidence and do not promote or generate paper targets. No threshold, lookback, asset, weighting, cap or window changes after results.
